{{Quote|There's no reproducing of Soldier Speak. Queens have a unique set of vocal cords and resonance cavities, which even Soldiers themselves don't have. Besides that, Soldier language utilizes at least five different resonances and pitch variants, not to mention an entirely different vocabulary from Common Speak.|[[Nyama]]|<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>}}
'''Quesoth Soldier Speak''', also known as '''Soldier Speak''', was a [[Language/Legends|language]] that was spoken the [[Quesoth]], an [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]. While Soldier Speak could be understood by both Quesoth [[Quesoth Soldier|Soldiers]] and some non-Quesoth, only Quesoth [[Queen/Legends|Queens]] had the vocal capacity to speak Soldier Speak. Furthermore, Soldier Speak could not be communicated via [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]], because comlinks lacked the capacity handle the various difference frequencies Soldier Speak was spoken in, and as a consequence, the Quesoth Queens used loudspeakers to communicate their commands to Soldiers. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[Empire of the Hand]] launched an [[Attack on the Red City|attack]] on Quethold and during the battle, the Imperial [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] destroyed all of the Quesoth loudspeakers except for one. The Imperials then used the remaining loudspeaker to play a Soldier Speak recording that ordered the Soldiers to leave the battle and defend the Queen.
